CREATE TABLE products (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  price       REAL NOT NULL,
  stock       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  image       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  category    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  featured    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  weight      INTEGER,
  updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
)

products.name: Bourbon Glaze
products.description:
Smooth bourbon warmth, the sweetness of honey, the umami of soy, a touch of star anise.
Glaze your pork belly, brush your ribs,
or charred wings for that sticky finish.
300ml

products.name: Burger Onions
products.description: Sweet pickled onions sliced thick for burgers and sandwiches. A backyard BBQ essential.

products.name: Carrot
products.description: Pickled carrots with a satisfying crunch. Tangy, sweet, and perfect as a side or snack.

products.name: Cauliflower
products.description: Pickled cauliflower florets with a zesty brine. Unexpected and delicious.

products.name: Cowboy Candy
products.description: Sweet and spicy candied jalapeños. The legendary condiment that goes on absolutely everything.

products.name: Cucumbers
products.description: Classic pickled cucumbers. Crunchy, tangy, and utterly addictive straight from the jar.

products.name: Roast Habanero
products.description:
Starts with a punch, finishes with flavour.
Made to accompany your food and not drown it out.
Add to smoked meats or anything that needs a kick.
250ml

products.name: Roast Jalapeño
products.description:
Fire-roasted and with a fresh, fruity bite and just a hint of sweetness.
Killer on burgers, tacos, or as a salsa upgrade for your next BBQ feast.
250ml

products.name: Sweet & Smokey
products.description:
Built for the pit, this is the everything sauce!
Smoky chipotle, a touch of sweet, and just enough heat.
Perfect on brisket, pulled pork, eggs, you name it!
300ml
